claims.observed_behavior: Defect. afol new calls the presence-only resolver, which reports governed when both strings are nonempty. The catalog resolver that validates roadmap/spec authority is not called by this path.
claims.intended_contract: F-22 requires rejection of nonexistent, inactive, or unrelated governance bindings before task execution and persistence of canonical path/hash authority.
claims.test_coverage: cli/tests/quick-task-command.test.ts:156-175 rejects fake authority only for quick-task; no equivalent normal-new test was found.

claims.observed_behavior: Defect. The registry computes approval metadata only for help/catalog output. main resolves restricted context but drops it when dispatching mutating adm, spec, adr, changelog, state, adapter, and hydrate handlers; adapter enable/disable has no context parameter or gate.
claims.intended_contract: Every real write must receive fail-closed approval and runtime provenance through one command-contract enforcement path.
claims.test_coverage: cli/tests/operation-context.test.ts:106-143 covers classification only. No focused integration test was found for restricted callers against the dropped-context mutators.

claims.observed_behavior: Defect. tools.json retains removed done and quick-task result forms and omits transition and governance. The manifest generator refreshes tools.json only as a managed hash; it never derives its tool payload from the registry.
claims.intended_contract: The agent-facing catalog claims generation from afol help --json and must describe the live command contract.

claims.observed_behavior: Defect. Spec checks persist in spec-gate.json, accept docs/arc/SPECS as a live fallback, are not consulted by closeSession, and failed spec/close paths do not append command-error records. ADR supersede takes two positionals rather than the specified --by form.
claims.intended_contract: The governing spec requires SQLite materialization, archive-only docs/arc, close blocking for unresolved required conflicts, command-error records, and adr supersede <old-id> --by <new-id>.

claims.observed_behavior: Additional defect. A malformed spec-gate.json is silently converted to an empty store. The next check or waiver writes that empty base plus one result, losing prior decision history; read-modify-write has no lock.
claims.intended_contract: F-22 requires corruption to be surfaced and reserves repair for an explicit command; decision history must remain durable.
claims.test_coverage: No malformed-store or concurrent-save test was found in cli/tests/spec-gate-system.test.ts.
